AAFC Outlook for Principal Field Crops (Canada)

outlook: Soybeans and corn finished lower on Wednesday while Chicago wheat gained. November soybeans fell 6½ cents to $12.77¼, giving back the morning's gains, as dry weather sped up the Midwest harvest following USDA's record soybean crop estimate, and Chinese buying of U.S. beans stayed thin. December corn slipped 2 cents to $4.80¾, still consolidating after the October WASDE raised the yield. December Chicago wheat rose 4 cents to $6.73¼, but Minneapolis December spring wheat lost 3¼ cents to $6.90¾ and ICE November canola eased C$1.50 to C$811.80 with Prairie harvest pressure; drone attacks on ships in the Black Sea added some risk but drew little lasting reaction.

news.title: Soybeans extend losses as US harvest expands
